Recent notes

  • MX17 and the future X17 search (19 Oct 2026) 2026-10-19StatusLNLILLMX17Papers

    Detectors (bench, SPS, fleet), what n_TOF showed (scintillators, singles vs pairs, energy), LNL and the big plastics, the neutron facilities, and the papers.

  • MX17 response simulation: where it stands (2026-10-18) 2026-10-18SimulationMicromegasGarfield

    The MX17 Micromegas response simulation against det3 cosmics: amplitude and inclined strip extent now match (26.5 mm drift column, bG 0.45); the inclined-Y peak strip and the neighbour timing still disagree, and an inter-strip coupling closes part of the latter. What was fixed, what is open, and ideas to close it.

  • Sim truth for track reco 2026-10-18SimulationMicromegasReconstructionWaveforms

    Response-sim truth vs the cosmic/beam track reco: hit-time ladder, wiring bug, angle closure, depth residuals (living)

  • MX17 bench X-width excess: saturation, closure toy, open questions 2026-10-17Cosmic benchMicromegasDiffusionSaturation

    Most of the bench X drift-width excess was ADC saturation. det3 keeps an unexplained +200–250 µm/√cm. det4/det7 have an amplitude-dependent footprint. A closure toy clears the estimator. Open consistency questions and how to settle them from existing data.

  • MX17 Detector Specification 2026-10-16MicromegasDetectorGeometryReview

    The MX17 resistive Micromegas as we model it, layer by layer: the Geant4 stack, the top view and the amplification region to scale, with every number

  • MX17 detector model: the physical forward model, and the old copy kernel 2026-10-16MicromegasDetector modelReconstruction

    Track to waveform in physical steps (drift, σ0 ≈ 0.4 mm readout footprint, RC spread along the resistive strips on Y only, X template, gas by setup), compared with the r06 copy kernel: Y better on all five chambers with no refit; X open. Slides.
